title: 雪の大谷攻城戦
subject: an April snow-clearing crew on the Tateyama Kurobe Alpine Route cutting the 20-metre 'snow corridor' at Murodo open with a rotary snow plough, the foreman directing it like a castle siege, the bus road due to open to tourists in a week
caption: Japanese gothic symphonic metal in the mid-2020s anime-band style: down-tuned seven-string guitars playing tight tremolo-picked and galloping riffs, double-kick drums, a cathedral pipe organ, a string section driving a spiccato ostinato, and harpsichord runs in the verses. Dense, dark, polished mix with wide choir reverb and a clean low end. Female mezzo-soprano lead with a theatrical, clear-toned delivery, half-sung verses rising to an operatic belt in the chorus, a mixed choir answering her. 148 BPM, D minor. Grandiose, mock-heroic and triumphant. No growled or screamed vocals, no metalcore breakdowns, no EDM synths, no pop-punk, no autotune.
lyrics:
[Intro - pipe organ chords, spiccato strings, double-kick drums enter]

[Verse 1]
四月の室堂 道はまだ白い
地図の上では ここにバスが通る
測量の竿を 雪に突き刺す
十八メートル 下にアスファルト

[Pre-Chorus]
親方が 無線で叫ぶ
「ロータリー 前へ」

[Chorus]
進め 進め 白い城壁へ
羽根車が 雪を空に吐く
一日三百メートル 攻め落とす
来週は 観光バスが来る

[Verse 2]
ブルドーザーが 先に掘り崩す
ロータリーが 後ろで壁を削る
雪の断面に 茶色い筋
三月の黄砂が 一本の線

[Chorus]
進め 進め 白い城壁へ
羽根車が 雪を空に吐く
一日三百メートル 攻め落とす
弁当の握り飯が 凍ってる

[Bridge - choir and organ, half-time]
雪の下から 道路標識
「この先 カーブ」 去年のままだ

[Chorus - full choir]
進め 進め 白い城壁へ
最後の一枚 突き破った
壁の上から 青空が見える
開通の朝 みんなで山を降りる

[Outro - organ alone, ringing out]
